title: 第13章 真正的赤尻马猴和通臂猿猴第14章 凌虚子和白衣秀士难兄难弟
slug: 西游开局获得太白金星传承
lines: 流沙河。
随着叶云讲述地仙之道和地仙法门。
群妖立刻陷入了一种朦朦胧胧的状态。
这其中，境界低的，理解起来就会极其困难，不过也为未来打下坚实的基础，并不亏。
而境界高的，自然是听的如痴如醉，映照自身，不再迷茫。
其中以老猴妖为最。
他只觉得，困扰自己多年的迷雾终于散开，有种拨云见日之感。
下一瞬，老猴妖竟然堪破仙凡壁障，成功晋入地仙初期。
仙境气息弥漫，瞬间惊动了在场其他的妖怪们。
他们凝目望去，顿时知晓了，老猴妖成功突破，晋升地仙境。
这让他们极其羡慕，同时内心也大受鼓舞。
“不错。”
叶云点了点头，作为最早跟随自己的妖怪，老猴妖的忠心自然不用怀疑。
如今成功晋升地仙境，可以说是苦尽甘来了。
而且实力强了，以后也能更好的为他做事。
“可惜，同为猴类，老猴妖的资质，不要说跟猴哥比，就连那猕猴王，禺狨王都完全比不了。”
“甚至，连花果山的四健将都不及。”
说起来，花果山四健将，两个是赤尻马猴，两个是通臂猿猴。
赤尻马猴和通臂猿猴，加上孙悟空的灵明石猴和六耳猕猴，则为混世四猴。
但看孙悟空和六耳猕猴的表现，再对比四健将，就显得四健将很弱。
而且灵明石猴和六耳猕猴在西游只有一个，四健将却有四个。
所以，叶云更倾向于四健将不是真正的赤尻马猴和通臂猿猴，只是沾了一些血脉而已。
真正的赤尻马猴和通臂猿猴，一个是如今被镇压在龟山之下的无支祁，一个便是封神时期的袁洪，也就是现在的四废星君。
脑海之中闪过这些。
这时，一道惊雷之声将叶云的注意力牵引回来。
只见乌云聚集，雷电汇聚。
正是老猴妖的成仙劫来了。
老猴妖虽然资质不是那般出色，血脉也一般。
但积累雄厚，加上叶云的法力滋养，所以这成仙劫对他来说，难度并不是很高。
在群妖的围观下，老猴妖飞上云端，主动迎接成仙之劫。
便听电闪雷鸣，振聋发聩，好似要祛除世间一切邪祟。
content_en:
Liusha River.
As Ye Yun talks about the way of the Earth Immortal and the Earth Immortal Dharma.
The group of demons immediately fell into a hazy state.
Among them, those with low level will be extremely difficult to understand, but it will also lay a solid foundation for the future, which is not a loss.
And those with high realms will naturally be mesmerized by listening to it, reflecting themselves and no longer confused.
Among them, the old monkey demon is the most important.
He just felt that the fog that had troubled him for many years finally cleared away, and he felt like he could see the sun through the clouds.
In the next moment, the old monkey demon broke through the barrier of immortality and successfully advanced to the early stage of earthly immortality.
The aura of the fairyland filled the air, instantly alarming the other monsters present.
They stared and knew immediately that the old monkey demon successfully broke through and was promoted to the fairyland.
This made them extremely envious, and at the same time they were also greatly encouraged.
"Not bad."
Ye Yun nodded. As the first monster to follow him, there was no need to doubt the loyalty of the old monkey monster.
Now that he has successfully been promoted to the fairyland, it can be said that all the hardships have come to an end.
And if you become stronger, you will be able to do better things for him in the future.
"Unfortunately, as they are both monkeys, the qualifications of the old monkey demon are completely incomparable to those of the monkey king, not to mention the monkey brother."
"Not even as good as the four top athletes from Huaguo Mountain."
Speaking of which, among the four heroes of Huaguo Mountain, two are red-breasted monkeys and two are monkeys.
The red-armed horse monkey and the long-armed monkey, plus Sun Wukong's spiritual stone monkey and the six-eared macaque, form the four monkeys in this world.
But looking at the performance of Sun Wukong and the six-eared macaque, and then comparing the four strong generals, it seems that the four strong generals are very weak.
Moreover, there is only one Lingming Stone Monkey and Six-eared Macaque in Journey to the West, but there are four of the Four Generals.
Therefore, Ye Yun is more inclined to believe that the four healthy generals are not the real red-armed monkeys and monkeys, but just have some blood.
Among the real red-armed monkeys and white-breasted monkeys, one is Wuzhi Qi who is now suppressed under Turtle Mountain, and the other is Yuan Hong during the Conferred God Period, who is now the Four-Dead Star Lord.
These flashed through my mind.
At this time, a sound of thunder drew Ye Yun's attention back.
I saw dark clouds gathering and thunder and lightning gathering.
It was the time when the old monkey demon became an immortal.
Although the old monkey demon's qualifications are not that outstanding, his bloodline is average.
But with his strong accumulation and the nourishment of Ye Yun's magic power, this tribulation of becoming an immortal was not very difficult for him.
Under the crowd of demons, the old monkey demon flew into the clouds and took the initiative to meet the catastrophe of becoming an immortal.
Then he heard the lightning and thunder, which was deafening and enlightening, as if he wanted to get rid of all the evil spirits in the world.
